title: Mayerthorpe Golf Course Campground
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: The course is located on Hwy 22 South just a mile from the intersection of Hwys 44 and 22. Mayerthorpe Golf Course is a fantastic 9 hole course that is fun for all ages. We take great pride in our greens and fairways and it shows! There is a beautiful campground that is adjacent to the course.
